title: Common Grace of God
definition: The common grace of God is His undeserved kindness shown broadly to humanity in restraining evil, providing blessings, and sustaining life.
summary: God shows kindness even to a fallen world through daily mercies and restraint.
christFocus: Jesus teaches that the Father gives sun and rain even to the unjust, while saving grace comes through Christ alone.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Common grace refers to God's kindness toward humanity broadly. He gives life, rain, food, family, beauty, conscience, skills, order, and restraint of evil even in a fallen world.

Common grace is not saving grace. It does not remove guilt or reconcile sinners to God. But it reveals God's patience, goodness, and generosity.

These mercies should lead people to gratitude and repentance, not presumption.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often take daily mercies for granted or assume they are deserved. Common grace matters because it reveals God's kindness and patience toward a world that depends on Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Notice God's daily mercies and give thanks. Let His kindness lead you to repentance and help you show kindness even to those who do not yet know Him.
